instruction: Type This report lists in Body, select the fx button, type length(, pick Output under Select on the Dynamic content tab, type ) and select Add.
title: Animation: open the expression editor with the fx button and add length(body('Select'))
intro: Press Play to watch steps 1 to 5: the fx button, the expression, then Add.

steps.caption: In Body, click at the end of the first line and type a space, This report lists and another space.
Select the fx button at the right edge of Body, just below the lightning bolt. The expression editor opens.
Click into the expression box and type length(
Switch to the Dynamic content tab.
Select Output under Select (type Output in the search box if you can't see it), then type ) to close the bracket.
The pink length(...) token is now in Body. In step 6 you type sessions. after it.
